name: TM7 Lamb Meatball, Red Pepper & Feta Rigatoni Bake
ingredients: 110 g fresh white breadcrumbs, for meatballs
4 g salt, plus extra to taste and for pasta water
1 g ground black pepper, plus extra to taste
350 g jarred roasted red peppers, drained
1200 g chopped tomatoes (3 x 400 g tins)
250 g feta cheese, crumbled and divided into two 125 g portions
Up to 150 g reserved pasta cooking water, if needed

steps.text: Put 800 g lamb mince, 110 g fresh white breadcrumbs, 2 egg yolks, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 4 g salt and 1 g black pepper into a large bowl. Mix gently by hand, then form 16 large meatballs (about 55-60 g each).

Preheat the air fryer to 190°C. Arrange the meatballs in a single layer, working in batches if necessary. Air fry 10-12 minutes at 190°C, turning halfway, until browned on the outside. The meatballs will finish cooking in the oven.
Put 180 g quartered onion and 15 g garlic into the TM7 mixing bowl. Chop 5 sec / speed 5, then scrape down the sides.
Add 30 g olive oil and cook 6 min / 120°C / speed 1.
Add 350 g drained roasted red peppers and 1200 g chopped tomatoes (3 x 400 g tins). Make sure the ingredients remain below the maximum fill mark. Cook 15 min / 100°C / speed 1.
Carefully blend the cooked tomato and pepper sauce, increasing speed gradually over 30 sec / speed 5-6, observing the TM7 instructions for blending hot liquids.
Add 60 g double cream, taste and season with a little extra salt or black pepper if needed. Cook 2 min / 90°C / speed 2.

While the sauce cooks, bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Cook 500 g dried rigatoni for about 2 minutes less than the packet directions, so it is slightly underdone. Reserve up to 150 g cooking water and drain.

Preheat the oven to 200°C fan. Put the drained rigatoni into a large deep baking dish or two medium dishes. Pour in the TM7 red pepper sauce and stir well. Stir through 125 g crumbled feta. Nestle the 16 browned lamb meatballs into the pasta, then scatter over the remaining 125 g feta and 50 g fresh breadcrumbs. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if the mixture looks too thick.

Bake uncovered at 200°C fan for 18-22 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden, and the meatballs are fully cooked (75°C at the centre). Allow to rest for 5 minutes. Scatter over 15 g fresh basil leaves and serve generously.
